tagline.en: GigaAI's GigaWorld-0 — a robotics world model that generates action-conditioned video for manipulation.
tagline.zh: GigaAI 的 GigaWorld-0——机器人世界模型,为操作任务生成动作条件化视频。

en: GigaWorld-0 is a robotics world model from GigaAI (open-gigaai). It predicts how a scene evolves as a robot acts, generating video conditioned on actions — useful for imagining and evaluating behavior before running it on hardware.

The project ships two 2B video checkpoints on Hugging Face: a pretraining model and a GR1-oriented variant. In WorldFoundry the GigaWorld-0 source is vendored in-tree and exposed through a runtime pipeline that resolves its inference entrypoint. Real generation additionally requires the checkpoints and per-task assets, staged separately.
In WorldFoundry you use GigaWorld-0 for robotics-world-model, video-generation, and action-conditioned generation tasks once those assets are in place.
zh: GigaWorld-0 是 GigaAI(open-gigaai)推出的机器人世界模型。它预测机器人动作过程中场景如何演变,基于动作生成视频——便于在真机运行前想象并评估行为。
项目在 Hugging Face 上提供两个 2B 视频 checkpoint:一个预训练模型,以及一个面向 GR1 的变体。在 WorldFoundry 中,GigaWorld-0 的源码以 in-tree 方式收录,并通过一个运行时 pipeline 暴露,该 pipeline 会解析其推理入口。真正的生成还需要 checkpoint 与各任务资产,需单独准备。
在 WorldFoundry 中,当资产就位后,你可将 GigaWorld-0 用于机器人世界模型、视频生成与动作条件化生成等任务。

whenToUse.en: Choose GigaWorld-0 when you want a robotics world model to generate action-conditioned video and preview manipulation outcomes.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用一个机器人世界模型生成动作条件化视频、预览操作结果时,选择 GigaWorld-0。

notFor.en: It generates predicted video, not control actions, and it can't run until its checkpoints and task assets are downloaded and staged.
notFor.zh: 它生成的是预测视频,而非控制动作,在其 checkpoint 与任务资产下载并准备好之前也无法运行。
